social_connection_frequency: how often the person connects with others socially (e.g., Daily, Weekly, Rarely)
gathering_size_preference: preferred size of social gatherings (e.g., small gatherings, large parties, both)
valued_friendship_traits: most valued traits in friendships (e.g., support, loyalty, honesty, humor)
conflict_resolution_style: preferred approach to resolving conflicts with others (e.g., Talk it out, Avoid conflict, Apologize first)
family_support_level: level of support received from family (e.g., Yes, Sometimes, No)
social_battery_recharge: preferred method for recharging social energy (e.g., Talking to someone, Alone time, Social media)
social_orientation_type: self-identified social orientation (e.g., Introvert, Extrovert, Ambivert, Not sure)
social_anxiety_level: level of social anxiety experienced (e.g., Avoid it, Nervous, Neutral, Excited)
emotional_expression_method: preferred method of expressing emotions (e.g., Stay silent, Talk openly, Write down)
primary_anger_sources: primary triggers or sources of anger (e.g., Injustice, Selfishness, Being interrupted, Unnecessary criticism)
target: friendship maintenance preference (0 - uses texting/social media/rarely keeps in touch, 1 - maintains long-distance friendships through calls)
